flipToBack.prose: Flip if Stolen Data Tapes are 'delivered' AND you control a battleground site with a Rebel AND you control a battleground system with a Rebel.

children.req: control-with: you control a battleground SITE with a Rebel
control-with: you control a battleground SYSTEM with a Rebel

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if you do not occupy a battleground site, OR do not occupy a battleground system, OR do not control any location.

children.req: occupy: you occupy a battleground site
occupy: you occupy a battleground system

requirementSemantics: Front flip mixes card-STATE (delivered Stolen Data Tapes, a keyword-state filter, not just on-table) with two CONTROL-WITH legs: the site and system must each be controlled AND have a Rebel there.
Back flip-back downgrades to OCCUPY for the site/system legs (mere presence suffices to stay flipped) but its third leg is CONTROL of any location.
Asymmetry to exploit: flipping forward needs Rebel control of bg site+system; staying on back only needs OCCUPATION of bg site+system plus control of at least one location anywhere.
typedIdentities: Filters.or(Filters.Alderaan_system, Filters.Tatooine_site) with target-filter Filters.or(Filters.Alderaan_system, Filters.battleground) (download)
Deploy ban: Filters.or(Filters.Sandwhirl, Filters.Strike_Planning, Filters.Admirals_Order, Filters.and(Icon.EPISODE_I, Filters.Jedi))
Back destiny evaluator: OccupiesWithEvaluator(self, playerId, Filters.battleground, Filters.and(Filters.Rebel, Filters.abilityLessThan(4)))
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup (required on objective deploy): deploy Tatooine system; deploy Tantive IV, non-[Reflections II] R2-D2, and Stolen Data Tapes to Tatooine system; deploy Dune Sea (Card203_019.java:52-90).

Both sides once per turn (DIPLOMATIC_MISSION_TO_ALDERAAN__DOWNLOAD_ALDERAAN_OR_TATOOINE_BATTLEGROUND_SITE, shared usage id): deploy Alderaan system or a Tatooine battleground site from Reserve Deck (DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.or(Filters.Alderaan_system, Filters.Tatooine_site), Filters.or(Filters.Alderaan_system, Filters.battleground), true)) (Card203_019.java:111-130; Card203_019_BACK.java:55-74).
otherObligations: Front remainder-of-game deploy ban: you may not deploy Sandwhirl, Strike Planning, Admiral's Orders, or [Episode I] Jedi (Card203_019.java:93-99).
Front: your Force drains at Tatooine system are -2 (Card203_019.java:106).
Front: until start of your first turn, Tantive IV may be forfeited to satisfy ALL battle damage against you (OptionalGameTextTriggerAction) (Card203_019.java:133-156).
Back: your total battle destiny +X, X = battlegrounds occupied by Rebels of ability < 4 (Card203_019_BACK.java:50).
Back: once per turn, if you just won a battle, may retrieve 1 Force (Card203_019_BACK.java:77-95).
No hard-lose/out-of-play condition on either side.

Strategic: 'delivered' Stolen Data Tapes state is the bottleneck; then hold Rebel control of one bg site + one bg system; after flip, never simultaneously lose occupation of bg site/system or control of all locations.
